newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Sylvan Inc Q2 net decreases.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Sylvan Inc Q2 net decreases.

text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended

NOTE: The company said its decline in net income for the second quarter of 1997 was in large part due to an effective income tax rate of 29 percent, as compared with 20 percent in the year-ago quarter.

Average currency translation rates in the company's principal currencies declined by approximately 11 percent for the second quarter of 1997, as compared with the year-ago period, and by 11 percent for the first six months of 1997, as compared with the prior year's six-month period.
Net income for the second quarter of 1997 included a one-time severance cost of $65,000 to reflect full implementation of the company's new Pennsylvania inoculum production facility.
